title: Fly-E Group, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Fly-E Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: FLYE) received a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications Staff deficiency letter on April 17, 2026, notifying the company that it failed to hold a required annual shareholder meeting within twelve months of its fiscal year ended March 31, 2025. The company has until June 1, 2026 to submit a compliance plan; if accepted, compliance deadline extends to September 28, 2026.
key_points: Company received Nasdaq deficiency letter on April 17, 2026 for failure to hold annual meeting within required timeframe (Listing Rule 5620(a))
Fiscal year ended March 31, 2025; annual meeting was required within 12 months but was not held
Compliance deadline: June 1, 2026 (45 days to submit plan)
If Nasdaq accepts compliance plan, company has until September 28, 2026 to regain compliance (180-day exception)
Company states delay is administrative; no disagreement among shareholders or Board
Company intends to convene annual meeting to regain compliance but cannot guarantee success
